description: APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT is a HyperLogLog sketch. It must not undercount distinct values that collide on 32-bit String.hashCode() ('Aa' and 'BB' both hash to 2112, which an earlier implementation merged), NULLs are ignored, an all-NULL column counts zero, small cardinalities are exact, and a moderate cardinality lands inside HLL's error bound. Converted 1:1 from functions/ApproxCountDistinctTest (now retired); its 1000-row Java-built INSERT becomes an INSERT ... SELECT over GENERATOR, which seeds the same 1000 distinct keys.
